### partial reads? 

![](/sockets/texfig/socket-flow-part-read-write-partial-reads.figure.svg){fig-alt="on one end: sock.send(b'X' * 6000); the other end: sometimes b'X' * 6000 == sock.recv(6000); or sometimes b'X' * 1490 == sock.recv(6000), b'X' * 2980 == sock.recv(4510); b'X' * 1530 == sock.recv(1530)"}


### partial writes 

![](/sockets/texfig/socket-flow-part-read-write-partial-writes.figure.svg){fig-alt="on on ened: sock.setblocking(False); sock.send(b'X' * 6000) == 1480; on the other end: b'X' * 1480 == sock.recv(6000) + no more data"}


### partial reads/writes 


* read/recv can have read less than requested 

   * read of zero bytes = end of file

* send/write can write less than requested… <br> but only on error or if non-blocking mode requested
